DISCOVERY 610, NO APPEARANCE. TENTATIVE RULING ADOPTED. PETITIONER'S MOTION FOR MONETARY AND EVIDENTIARY SANCTIONS IS GRANTED. RESPONDENT HAS FAILED TO COMPLY WITH THE OCTOBER 20, 2003 AND NOVEMBER 19, 2003 ORDERS OF THE COURT. FAILURE TO RESPOND WAS AN ABUSE OF THE DISCOVERY PROCESS AND A VIOLATION OF COURT ORDERS. RESPONDENT IS PROHIBITED FROM PRESENTING EVIDENCE RELATING TO THE FOLLOWING SUBJECTS: AGREEMENTS, CURRENT INCOME, SEPARATE PROPERTY CONTENTIONS, CLAIMS OF REIMBURSEMENT, CREDITS, HEALTH ISSUES, AND INFORMATION CONCERNING HIS ABILITY TO WORK AS A RESULT OF INJURIES SUSTAINED IN A YACHTING ACCIDENT. RESPONDENT IS ORDERED TO PAY $1,000 IN ATTORNEY'S FEES AND $25.30 IN COSTS WITHIN 30 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER. COMM: BRUCE E. CHAN
